tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground (body background; the browser's theme-color). Everything sits on it. The avatar ring and selected swatch ring are cut out of it.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass surfaces: cards (app-card, .nx-tile) and the font picker's options, over bg with backdrop-filter blur(12px). Not text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and tile outlines, row dividers (.nx-rows, .nx-kv, .nx-table), the pill nav and segmented control, unchecked chips. Decorative; the high-contrast themes raise it to a visible border.

tokens.name: line2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairlines: ghost buttons, inputs, raised panels (menu, dialog, drawer), pill notes, step rings, the blockquote rule. Control borders, so 3:1 on bg in the high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, glass, well and raised: body copy, headings, values in key/value lists, active nav and tabs. 17:1 on bg in both dark and light.

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, glass and raised: ghost button and chip text, markdown prose, status labels, rows. 12:1 on bg in dark, 11:1 in light.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg and glass: field labels, subtitles, nav links, tab labels, key names in .nx-kv, quiet links. 6.9:1 on bg in dark, 5.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: muted2
tokens.usage: The quietest text: mono labels (.nx-label), notes (.nx-note), handles, empty states, step names, calendar weekdays. The source's pair misses 4.5:1 on bg (4.3:1 in dark, 3.9:1 in light; 4.0:1 on raised): keep it to labels and notes beside stronger text, never for anything only it says. The high-contrast themes raise it to 12:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The violet as text and marks: links in the kit (.nx-link), the serif accent in headings (.nx-accent), active tab underline, focus rings (2px outline), the today mark, chip text when on, the bell badge, spinner. 8.7:1 on bg in dark, 5.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: The violet as a fill: primary buttons (.nx-btn), the active segment, checked toggles, done steps, chosen calendar days, the brand mark square, the ambient glow. on-fill (white) text on it: 4.5:1 in dark, 5.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken grounds: inputs (.nx-input), code and pre in markdown, a hidden mention. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Floating panels: the profile menu, dialogs, the mobile drawer and right pane, select options, the update toast. Text on it is ink; bordered with line2 and shadowed with shadow-float.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a dialog, drawer or open pane, with backdrop-filter blur.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The colour inside the floating shadows (see the Shadows family); not for text.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success and "active" or "home" statuses, as a dot (app-status) or text; the public audience's colour. As text on bg: 11.7:1 in dark; 4.2:1 in light (the source's pair, just under 4.5:1: in light use it as a dot beside a label, or for bold text 19px+). 8:1 in light-high.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Pending, requested and extended statuses, the warn callout tint (.nx-callout.warn); the familiars audience. As text on bg: 11.7:1 in dark; 4.3:1 in light (the source's pair, just under 4.5:1: a dot beside a label there). 8.2:1 in light-high.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger as text and marks: errors (.nx-error), the ghost danger button's text and border tint, rejected or blocked statuses; the core household audience. On bg: 9.6:1 in dark, 4.6:1 in light.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger as a fill: .nx-btn.danger with on-fill (white) text. 4.1:1 in dark and 4.5:1 in light: the source's pair, so keep the label short at control size; light-high raises it to 6.7:1.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text (body a, .nx-markdown a). Equal to accent in every theme; use link where the thing is a hyperlink, accent for the colour as decoration.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: A link under the pointer; the high-contrast themes make it full ink.

tokens.name: selected-bg
tokens.usage: The chosen calendar day or a selected option's ground: a strong violet fill in dark, a soft tint in light. Pair with selected-ink.

tokens.name: selected-ink
tokens.usage: Text on selected-bg: white on the dark theme's fill, accent on the light theme's tint.

tokens.name: vis-public
tokens.usage: Audience dot for Public (app-vis-chip, the visibility picker). Dots carry a label beside them; never colour alone.

tokens.name: vis-community
tokens.usage: Audience dot for Community members.

tokens.name: vis-members
tokens.usage: Audience dot for Members (same hue as the community).

tokens.name: vis-familiars
tokens.usage: Audience dot for House familiars.

tokens.name: vis-extended-family
tokens.usage: Audience dot for Extended family.

tokens.name: vis-event-organizers
tokens.usage: Audience dot for Event organizers.

tokens.name: vis-connections
tokens.usage: Audience dot for Connections.

tokens.name: vis-core-house
tokens.usage: Audience dot for the Core household.

tokens.name: vis-groups
tokens.usage: Audience dot for Shares a group.

tokens.name: vis-only-me
tokens.usage: The "Only me" dot (no audience): the muted2 grey.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and marks on fill, danger-fill, selected-bg (dark) and avatar colours: button labels, the active segment, the toggle knob, the brand mark's diamond, done-step ticks. On the avatar palette a bold initial sits beside the name, never alone (3.3:1 to 5.6:1).

tokens.name: tone-teal
tokens.usage: The one fixed status tone ([data-tone="teal"], sexual-health statuses), the same in every theme: 7.2:1 on bg in dark but 2.6:1 in light, so only ever a dot beside a label.

tokens.name: avatar-violet
tokens.usage: Avatar palette 1 of 7 (app-avatar PALETTE): a profile's initial on this when it has no favourite colour, picked by a hash of its id. White initial on it.

tokens.name: avatar-rust
tokens.usage: Avatar palette 2 of 7.

tokens.name: avatar-moss
tokens.usage: Avatar palette 3 of 7.

tokens.name: avatar-ochre
tokens.usage: Avatar palette 4 of 7.

tokens.name: avatar-sky
tokens.usage: Avatar palette 5 of 7.

tokens.name: avatar-plum
tokens.usage: Avatar palette 6 of 7.

tokens.name: avatar-rose
tokens.usage: Avatar palette 7 of 7; also the last stop of the custom-colour swatch's conic gradient.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Centred single-message pages (.nx-center h1): login, not found, suspended.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page heading (app-page-head h1); 1.875rem under 600px. Its last word may be set in accent (serif italic, accent colour).

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: h3 in people's markdown (.nx-markdown h3), in ink.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: h4 in markdown; h5 and h6 drop to 0.875rem.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Profiles, events, groups and borrowing for the house and its people.
styles.usage: The body default (13.5px at the browser's 16px), inputs, dialog text, person names, tab labels. All text is in rem: data-text-size scales the root to 90%, 115% or 135%.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: I cook on Sundays; come hungry.
styles.usage: Markdown people write (.nx-markdown) in ink2, and a page head's subtitle in muted.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Rows in key/value lists and tables (.nx-kv, .nx-table), toggles, errors (.nx-error), the update toast, menu items.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons (.nx-btn, .nx-ghost, .nx-link), segments, pill nav links, field labels (.nx-field), callouts, statuses, calendar days, pill notes.

styles.name: tier
styles.usage: Audience chips in the visibility picker, pseudonym kinds, a card's header action.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chips (.nx-chip, app-vis-chip), notes (.nx-note), step names, the font picker's labels.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: The serif italic accent (.nx-serif): the emphasised word of a page title, at the title's size, in accent colour (.nx-accent). A profile's favourite font replaces the family, size-adjusted to 0.51.

styles.name: empty
styles.usage: Empty states (.nx-empty) in muted2; the glyph in a group or resource tile (.nx-glyph).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Mono eyebrow labels, uppercase (.nx-label): card headers, dialog eyebrows, table heads, calendar weekdays, circle names in menus. In muted2.

styles.name: handle
styles.usage: Handles under names (app-person .sub, the profile switcher), in muted2.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in markdown, on well; the markdown help line (.nx-mono).

spacing.note: The kit has no named spacing variables; these are the pixel steps its padding and gaps use, named here. Text sizes are rem, spacing is px.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a pill nav or drawer nav between links; chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pill nav and segmented-control inset (3px for .nx-seg); calendar nav gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and status rows; field label to input; menu panel inset; chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between pills (.nx-pills), tile content, actions in a page head, dialog footer buttons.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Row padding in .nx-rows and .nx-table; callout vertical padding; person row gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bento and grid gaps; input horizontal padding; card header gap; skeleton rows.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Below a card header; dialog body gap; top-action gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Tile padding; button horizontal padding (.nx-btn); top bar gap; under tabs; dialog body top.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card padding (app-card); top bar vertical padding; content top padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs; below a page head.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; the content grid's column gap.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Top bar horizontal padding; the default avatar size.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Content horizontal padding on desktop; the toggle's width.

radius.note: radius-card and radius-input are the source's own variables; the rest name the fixed radii its components use.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, the menu panel, the drawer's profile list (--radius-card).

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, checks, the font picker's options, markdown preview, pseudonym choices (--radius-input).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: buttons, chips, segmented controls, the pill nav, pill notes, view-as trigger. Circles use 50%.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs (app-dialog). Photo viewer images use 18px.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: Floating menus (view-as) and the update toast; the photo cropper frame.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Rows in the profile switcher; drawer nav links use 12px.

tokens.name: radius-soft
tokens.usage: Calendar days and month nav buttons, menu items, code blocks (pre).

tokens.name: radius-bone
tokens.usage: Skeleton lines and the brand mark's square; inline code uses 4px, a hidden-field stripe 4px.

shadow.note: Only floating things cast shadows; surfaces on the page are told apart by hairlines and glass, never by shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The profile menu panel and dialogs: 0 30px 80px in the theme's shadow colour.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Small floating menus (view-as): 0 18px 40px. The update toast uses 0 16px 40px.

tokens.name: shadow-avatar-inset
tokens.usage: The hairline inside an avatar or colour swatch, so a light photo keeps an edge.

opacity.note: Tints the kit mixes from the theme's rgb triples (ink-rgb, acc-rgb, fill-rgb): alpha over the base colour.

tokens.name: tint-hover
tokens.usage: rgba(ink-rgb, 0.05): a ghost button or calendar day under the pointer; unchecked chip ground; the pill nav ground is 0.04, active link 0.09.

tokens.name: tint-accent-soft
tokens.usage: rgba(acc-rgb, 0.08): callout ground, a checked audience chip, the chosen font option; its border at 0.22 to 0.4.

tokens.name: tint-accent-on
tokens.usage: rgba(acc-rgb, 0.16): a chip that is on (.nx-chip.on), a mention bubble (0.14), the current step ring (0.15).

tokens.name: tint-fill-marked
tokens.usage: rgba(fill-rgb, 0.3): a calendar day with an event; a day inside a chosen range is 0.25; text selection is acc-rgb at 0.3.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The ambient violet haze behind the top of every page (radial gradient of fill-rgb at this alpha to 0); 0 in the high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled button; a covered audience chip is 0.55.
